shared_elements: shallow (low) relief carving on tan/buff stone
horizontal band of small repeated motifs across the upper area
justification: Both are buff stone slabs worked in shallow relief and both carry a horizontal band of small repeated units near the top above larger profile figures, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is densely packed with regimented rectangular sign-blocks in vertical columns framing an elaborately costumed human figure carved with fine internal detail, while B is sparse, with widely spaced, simplified animal silhouettes on an uncluttered ground and no human figure or column ordering.
